name: popover
title: Popover
description: Styled Solid popover component backed by Keystone overlay positioning and dismissal.

meta.customization: Style the generated wrappers through mason-popover classes while Keystone owns positioning, dismissal, and layer ordering.

parity.baseUi: Thin vertical covers Root/Trigger/Portal/Positioner/Popup-style anatomy, controlled open state, floating placement, outside/Escape dismissal, and Mason styling hooks. Gaps: modal mode, arrow geometry, anchor override, focus manager depth, collision CSS variables, and transition status metadata remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Matches Solid Popover/Popper composition for trigger, portal/content, controlled state, positioning, and dismissable-layer direction. Gaps: create-hide-outside/modal variants, forceMount transition lifecycle, and richer focus restoration policies remain follow-up work.
